source: external POST :9999/trigger for the same jobId with unique logId and payload fields
sink: JobThread.pushTriggerQueue adds logId to triggerLogIdSet and TriggerRequest to an unbounded LinkedBlockingQueue
driver: failed or slow trigger processing versus request rate; unique logId and executorParams/glueSource field size
dimension: queue element count, heap object count, queued request payload retention
retention: queued TriggerRequest and logId are retained until the JobThread worker polls and executes them
bound: LinkedBlockingQueue is constructed without capacity; triggerLogIdSet has no size cap; duplicate logId check does not constrain unique logIds
default_reachability: same default exposed executor and weak default token/appname as XXL-JOB-APP-STATIC-0001
dynamic_probe: Trigger default demoJobHandler faster than it can finish, vary logId and executorParams size, measure queue length via instrumentation/JFR, heap, GC, latency and service availability.
